statements.text: For the 2025 transfers, employees who have completed five years of service at a station as of April 30, 2025, are subject to compulsory transfer.
statements.quote: Employees who have completed five (5) years of service at a station as on 30-04-2025 shall be transferred compulsorily.

statements.text: In computing the station period, periods of leave that do not exceed six months are counted, whereas periods of deputation outside the Department are not counted.
statements.quote: Periods of leave not exceeding six months shall be counted towards the station period. Periods of deputation outside the Department shall not be counted.

statements.text: If an employee is transferred within the same headquarters town, the service at both offices is treated as service at one station.
statements.quote: Where an employee has been transferred within the same headquarters town, the service at both offices shall be treated as service at one station.
